summary: Full backend + frontend regression testing of ProtectedRoute refresh bug fix. Backend authorization (401/403) enforced correctly on all admin endpoints. Frontend correctly keeps customer on /dashboard on refresh, redirects customer OFF any /admin/* URL to /dashboard, does NOT render admin sidebar/table, and makes NO /api/admin/* calls. Admin regression flow works: admin can access /admin/orders and refresh keeps them there with admin-orders-table rendered. Unauthenticated /dashboard/orders correctly redirects to /login.

issues: Date range pickers use browser-default mm/dd/yyyy input instead of shadcn Calendar component

critical_code_review_comments: ProtectedRoute.jsx implementation differs from the description in the problem statement. Problem statement says: 'added a useEffect that re-checks role on every user change' and 'explicit access-denied render branch' with data-testid=access-denied. Actual file uses only <Navigate> (no useEffect, no access-denied testid). The behavior is still correct via <Navigate replace>, but the described data-testid='access-denied' element does NOT exist in the code. Any test relying on that testid will fail. If E1 intended to ship an access-denied screen, the code must be updated.
Route order: The Navigate on role mismatch sends user to '/dashboard' — good. On loading, returns loading-guard until useAuth resolves — good. No admin content flash observed.
test_credentials: Customer qrtest@zeroaxis.in / Test@1234; Admin zeroaxis.pvtltd.in@gmail.com / admin123 — both verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend admin authorization is solid: 401 unauth, 403 customer, 200 admin on /api/admin/stats. Playwright test verified: (1) customer refresh at /dashboard/orders stays and no admin API calls; (2) customer visiting /admin, /admin/customers, /admin/orders is redirected to /dashboard with no admin data; (3) admin can access and refresh /admin/orders with admin-sidebar and admin-orders-table rendered; (4) unauth is redirected to /login. NOTE: The 'access-denied' testid mentioned in the request is NOT in ProtectedRoute.jsx — redirection is used instead. When re-running Playwright, clear cookies between customer/admin sessions to avoid stale session issues (initial admin login attempt failed because customer session cookie was still active).
rca of the issue: Not applicable — bug fix verified working. Root cause of original bug (customer refresh landing on admin route) was that ProtectedRoute did not re-check role after auth resolved. Current implementation gates on `loading || user===null` returning loading-guard, then Navigate on role mismatch — which cleanly prevents the previous flash/mis-render.
